role: The server world for the Nether and the End: shares the overworld's map storage and scoreboard, reads the overworld's WorldInfo through a DerivedWorldInfo (one clock, one weather), and saves no level.dat of its own.
scope_reason: The Nether and the End are in scope (SPEC Decisions).

members.name: WorldServerMulti
members.note: the DerivedWorldInfo clock: the no-sky worlds read the overworld's already-advanced time (servertick_tick_head, sleep.c)

members.name: saveLevel
members.note: empty override; native does not save level.dat per dimension

notes: Map storage sharing is moot (maps = off) and the scoreboard is not part of the native game.
